तॄ {c1c} P. (तरति, ततार, अतारीत्,
तरिरी-ष्यति, तीर्ण)
1 To cross over,
cross; केनोडुपेन परलोकनदीं तरिष्ये

. (b) To sail across,
navigate (as a river).
--3 To float, swim;
शिला तरिष्यत्युदके न पर्णं

.
--4 (a) To get over, surmount,
overcome, overpower; धीरा हि
तरंत्यापदं

. (b) To subdue, destroy,
become master of.
--5 To go to the
end of, master completely;

.
--6 To fulfil, accomplish,
perform (as a promise); दैवात्तीर्णप्रतिज्ञः

.
--7 To be saved or
rescued, escape from; गावो
वर्षभयात्तीर्णा वयं तीर्णा महाभयात् Hariv.
--8 To
acquire, gain.
--9 To move forward
rapidly.
--10 To fill completely,
pervade.
--11 To live through (a
definite period).
--12 To deliver,
liberate from.
--13 To strive together,
compete. --Pass. (तीर्यते) To be
crossed &c. --Caus. (तारयति-ते)
1
To carry or lead over.
--2 To cause
to arrive at.
--3 To save, rescue,
deliver, liberate. --Desid. (तितीर्षति.
तितरिषति, तितरीषति) To wish to cross
&c.; दोर्भ्यां तितीर्षति तरंगवतीभुजंगं
K.
